The plate is square and about 24 cm across, which suggests a dinner plate. The roasted Brussels sprouts cover roughly a quarter of its surface. I count about 40 small sprouts, and at roughly 10-12 g each that comes to about 400-450 g. That seems too heavy for the footprint, though. Many of the sprouts look small, around 2.5-3 cm, so about 8 g each is more reasonable. That gives roughly 320 g, but they may be halved or trimmed, so I'll settle on about 280 g. I can't see any separate oil or sauce, so I'm not listing any.
